Container.Name: pinebridge-mt5
Container.Overview: Pinebridge: TradingView alerts to MetaTrader 5. Send TradingView alerts straight to MetaTrader 5 on your own Unraid server. No paid signal-relay service, no VPS. This container is the MetaTrader 5 side: it runs a full Windows 11 VM (dockur/windows, KVM/QEMU) that installs MetaTrader 5 and the TradingViewZeroMQExecutor EA by itself on first boot -- no files to download. First boot takes roughly 15-70 minutes (Windows download + install, then MT5 setup); watch it via the WebUI. Requires /dev/kvm on the host (enable virtualization in BIOS) and your own Windows license for anything beyond evaluation use.
Container.Requires: Virtualization (VT-x/AMD-V) enabled in BIOS so /dev/kvm exists. Test with a demo broker account first.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: noVNC web viewer -- watch/control the Windows desktop in a browser

Config.Name: ZMQ Port
Config.Description: ZeroMQ port the EA listens on -- pinebridge-bridge connects to 172.17.0.1 (this server, from Docker) or [Unraid IP]:this port

Config.Name: MT5_SERVER
Config.Description: Your broker's MT5 server name, exactly as shown in MT5 (e.g. MetaQuotes-Demo)

Config.Name: MT5_SYMBOL
Config.Description: Chart symbol the EA attaches to on startup (the EA trades whatever symbol each signal names)

Config.Name: CPU_CORES
Config.Description: CPU cores allocated to the VM

Config.Name: USERNAME
Config.Description: Windows account username (not your broker login)

Config.Name: PASSWORD
Config.Description: Windows account password (not your broker login) -- change this

Config.Name: Storage
Config.Description: Persistent Windows VM disk image (keep this on cache/SSD if you can)
